sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was meaningfully raised: the first full-year 2026 capex guide, while enormous, came with operating income still guided above 2025, and the revenue guide for Q1 2026 included a 4% currency tailwind. The feared numbers arrived with reassurance attached, and the stock had already fallen about 17% bracing for this guide, indicating the bar was lowered. The score is +0.50 because guidance was raised materially (operating income guided above 2025 despite higher spend) and the improvement is organic (not primarily attributed to FX or one-time items).

summary.revenue: $58.9B, up 25% year over year, near the top of the guide. Family of Apps ad revenue $58.1B, up 24%. Reality Labs $955M, down 12%.
summary.guidance: Q1 2026 revenue guided to $53.5B to $56.5B with a 4% currency tailwind. First full-year 2026 guides: expenses $162B to $169B and capex $115B to $135B, nearly double 2025. Operating income still guided above 2025 despite the spend.
key_risks: Legal and regulatory headwinds in the EU and US, with trials scheduled this year that may result in a material loss.
Reality Labs losses expected to stay near 2025 levels before improving.
Currency tailwinds fade later in 2026 and EU ad changes may bite.
key_opportunities: Sales of glasses more than tripled last year.
WhatsApp paid messaging crossed $2 billion annual run rate.
30% increase in output per engineer since the start of 2025.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management language includes 'We are now seeing a major AI acceleration' and 'Operating income still guided above 2025 despite the spend,' indicating confidence in the forward outlook.
